evals.prompt: Does index.html look AI-generated? It is a landing page for a ferry booking service built from a one-paragraph brief.
evals.expected_output: Machine findings are gathered first and listed as evidence; every judgement gate gets a verdict row; the sameness read names what belongs only to this brief or says nothing does.
expectations: Runs findings.mjs (and scan.sh) or uses findings passed in, before judging, and does not re-judge machine-owned rules.
Renders or views the page before giving visual verdicts, and marks gates it could not see as NOT ASSESSABLE rather than CLEAR.
Gives every judgement gate in references/gates.md a row; AI-product gates are omitted because the product is not an AI product.
Never names a theme, starter or catalogue look, and never proposes one as the fix.

evals.prompt: Review this page for slop. The browser pass could not run on this machine (findings.mjs exited 2), but the static pass found two issues.
evals.expected_output: The UNVERIFIED banner leads the report; static findings are still reported; gates needing rendered evidence are NOT ASSESSABLE.
expectations: Copies the UNVERIFIED banner to the top of the report.
Still reports the two static findings as evidence instead of treating the run as failed.
Does not record the browser-owned checks as clean.
Produces a report that check-report.mjs accepts.

evals.prompt: Review this page. It follows a frozen direction contract that calls for oversized outlined numerals as section markers; the page also has a three-equal-card feature row the contract never mentions.
evals.expected_output: The direction-evidenced numerals are JUSTIFIED with the contract line as the reason; the card row is CONFIRMED SLOP because the direction does not trace to it.
expectations: Reads the direction source before adjudicating.
Marks the evidenced trait JUSTIFIED and cites the contract line, not consistency or polish.
Marks the untraced card grid CONFIRMED SLOP.
Does not suggest a different visual direction or a catalogue look.

evals.prompt: Review the assistant page of our agent product: a centred prompt box with suggestion chips over a soft glow, sparkle icons on generated answers, and a three-dot typing indicator.
evals.expected_output: AI product: yes; the AI-product gates are adjudicated, and the sameness read names the category template.
expectations: Sets AI product: yes and gives each AI-product gate a row.
Marks the stock sparkle marker, the prompt-box hero and the typing indicator as CONFIRMED SLOP unless something names their job.
Names the category convergence in the sameness read rather than listing seven small findings only.
Keeps its findings separate from ui-design-review and design-refine rather than merging them.
